title: Weekly orders by region
description: Number of orders and revenue per region for last week (Monday to Sunday), excluding cancelled orders. Uses the team's standard 'last week' filter on orders.created_at.
sql_content:
SELECT o.region,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.total) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Orders per region: last week vs the week before (UNION ALL)
description: Week-over-week order counts per region, one row per region and week, built with UNION ALL over the two standard week windows.
sql_content:
SELECT 'last_week' AS period, o.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY o.region
UNION ALL
SELECT 'previous_week' AS period, o.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '2 weeks'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY region, period

title: Orders per region: week-over-week change (CTE)
description: Last week's order count per region next to the previous week's, with the absolute and percentage change. CTE variant of the week-over-week comparison.
sql_content:
WITH last_week AS (
  SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
  GROUP BY o.region
), previous_week AS (
  SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '2 weeks'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT COALESCE(l.region, p.region) AS region,
       COALESCE(l.order_count, 0) AS last_week,
       COALESCE(p.order_count, 0) AS previous_week,
       COALESCE(l.order_count, 0) - COALESCE(p.order_count, 0) AS change,
       ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(l.order_count, 0) - COALESCE(p.order_count, 0))
             / NULLIF(p.order_count, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM last_week l
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_week p ON p.region = l.region
ORDER BY region

title: Top 10 customers by revenue
description: The ten customers with the highest lifetime revenue from non-cancelled orders, with their order count.
sql_content:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.country,
       COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.total) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

title: Sales by product category
description: Units sold and revenue per product category from order line items, excluding cancelled orders.
sql_content:
SELECT p.category,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Average order value per month
description: Average order total and order count per calendar month over the last 12 months, excluding cancelled orders.
sql_content:
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.created_at)
ORDER BY month

title: Inactive customers (no order in 90 days)
description: Customers who have not placed any order in the last 90 days, including those who never ordered, with their last order date.
sql_content:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.country, MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order_at
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country
HAVING MAX(o.created_at) IS NULL
    OR MAX(o.created_at) < now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY last_order_at NULLS FIRST, c.id

title: Customer revenue rank within each region
description: Ranks customers by revenue inside each region with a window function and keeps the top 3 per region.
sql_content:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT o.region, o.customer_id, SUM(o.total) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY o.region, o.customer_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT r.region, r.customer_id, r.revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY r.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM revenue r
)
SELECT ranked.region, c.name, ranked.revenue, ranked.revenue_rank
FROM ranked
JOIN customers c ON c.id = ranked.customer_id
WHERE ranked.revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY ranked.region, ranked.revenue_rank

title: Order status breakdown per region last week
description: Counts of paid, shipped, delivered and cancelled orders per region for last week, using aggregate FILTER (WHERE ...) clauses.
sql_content:
SELECT o.region,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'paid') AS paid,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'shipped') AS shipped,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered') AS delivered,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY o.region

title: Daily revenue with running total last week
description: Revenue per day for last week with a cumulative running total computed by a window function.
sql_content:
SELECT date_trunc('day', o.created_at) AS day,
       SUM(o.total) AS revenue,
       SUM(SUM(o.total)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('day', o.created_at)) AS running_total
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', o.created_at)
ORDER BY day

title: Best-selling products last week
description: Top 5 products by units sold last week, with revenue, joining order_items to orders and products.
sql_content:
SELECT p.name, p.category,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5

title: Most recent order of each customer
description: One row per customer with their latest order (date, region, total), using DISTINCT ON.
sql_content:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.customer_id)
       o.customer_id, c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.region, o.total, o.created_at
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.customer_id, o.created_at DESC

title: New customers per month by country
description: Number of customers who signed up each month over the last 12 months, split by country.
sql_content:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.created_at) AS month,
       c.country,
       COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers c
WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.created_at), c.country
ORDER BY month, c.country

title: Cancellation rate per region (last 30 days)
description: Share of cancelled orders per region over the last 30 days, computed with FILTER (WHERE ...) and NULLIF to avoid division by zero.
sql_content:
SELECT o.region,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cancellation_pct
FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY cancellation_pct DESC

title: Repeat customers last week
description: Customers who placed more than one order last week, with their order count and spend.
sql_content:
SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.total) AS spend
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week'
  AND o.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 1
ORDER BY order_count DESC, spend DESC
